title: Lane
summary: Lane is one of the members of Lucas Casterwill's team along with Dellix. Although more calm and subdued than her teammates, Lane won't hesitate to stand up for what she thinks is right and help out her fellow Seekers in battle.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Lane served as a guardian of the Casterwill library in Paris, France, alongside Dellix. The two of them permitted Sophie Casterwill to enter, without their intervention, upon seeing her enter the enchanted doorway which would only permit a member of the Casterwill family to pass. [Memory Lane]

Along with Lucas and Dellix, Lane later attacked the Huntik team when they returned to the library looking for information on the Willblade. Summoning her Wildwood Druid Titan, Lane and her team appeared to have the upper hand but this changed when Zhalia revealed her Titans hidden by her Thoughtspecter power. Lane revealed that they were searching for the location of an evil Amulet, Void. Lane later helped to rescue Lok and Sophie, and fought off the Organization Suits. [Chasing Void]

Lane was present at the meeting of the Casterwill family at the Fortress of Iron Will. [Sophie on Trial] When a huge Blood Spiral army attacked, Lane and Dellix joined the Foundation and the Casterwills in their fight. They clashed with Lucas who wanted to figure out a way to escape, but Lane ultimately convinced Lucas to join them and help Dante's team. [The Spiral War]

Lane travelled with Lucas and Dellix to the Spiral Mark on a Scramjet driven by Scarlet Byrne. [The Spiral Mark] During the final battle against the Blood Spiral, Lane was injured and rendered unconscious by a Psikofen Titan. [Lok and the Betrayer] She regained consciousness however and was seen celebrating with the rest of the Foundation and Casterwills following the defeat of the Betrayer. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E40 Lane.png|thumb|200px]]
Lane is obedient to Lucas, but can and will stand her ground when she thinks he is wrong. However, she is more meek than Dellix, and less likely to speak out if she thinks Lucas is wrong. She seems to get sad when Lucas makes harsh decisions, but also has some faith in him and knows that he will change his mind seeing that the way he refused to go is correct. She and Dellix have some influence on Lucas' behaviour, and she may also be close to Lucas due to her backward glance as she and Dellix ran off to go and fight. {{source|The Spiral War}} She was also vocal in her initial mistrust of [[Zhalia Moon]], unaware that Zhalia was listening. {{source|Chasing Void}}

full_text:
Lane is one of the members of Lucas Casterwill's team along with Dellix. Although more calm and subdued than her teammates, Lane won't hesitate to stand up for what she thinks is right and help out her fellow Seekers in battle. 

==History==
Lane served as a guardian of the Casterwill library in Paris, France, alongside Dellix. The two of them permitted Sophie Casterwill to enter, without their intervention, upon seeing her enter the enchanted doorway which would only permit a member of the Casterwill family to pass. [Memory Lane]

Along with Lucas and Dellix, Lane later attacked the Huntik team when they returned to the library looking for information on the Willblade. Summoning her Wildwood Druid Titan, Lane and her team appeared to have the upper hand but this changed when Zhalia revealed her Titans hidden by her Thoughtspecter power. Lane revealed that they were searching for the location of an evil Amulet, Void. Lane later helped to rescue Lok and Sophie, and fought off the Organization Suits. [Chasing Void]

Lane was present at the meeting of the Casterwill family at the Fortress of Iron Will. [Sophie on Trial] When a huge Blood Spiral army attacked, Lane and Dellix joined the Foundation and the Casterwills in their fight. They clashed with Lucas who wanted to figure out a way to escape, but Lane ultimately convinced Lucas to join them and help Dante's team. [The Spiral War]

Lane travelled with Lucas and Dellix to the Spiral Mark on a Scramjet driven by Scarlet Byrne. [The Spiral Mark] During the final battle against the Blood Spiral, Lane was injured and rendered unconscious by a Psikofen Titan. [Lok and the Betrayer] She regained consciousness however and was seen celebrating with the rest of the Foundation and Casterwills following the defeat of the Betrayer. [Dante's Return]

==Personality==

Lane is obedient to Lucas, but can and will stand her ground when she thinks he is wrong. However, she is more meek than Dellix, and less likely to speak out if she thinks Lucas is wrong. She seems to get sad when Lucas makes harsh decisions, but also has some faith in him and knows that he will change his mind seeing that the way he refused to go is correct. She and Dellix have some influence on Lucas' behaviour, and she may also be close to Lucas due to her backward glance as she and Dellix ran off to go and fight. [The Spiral War] She was also vocal in her initial mistrust of Zhalia Moon, unaware that Zhalia was listening. [Chasing Void]

==Abilities==
Lane seems to prefer far-ranged combat styles such as using Titans and spells as opposed to using martial arts or physical strength. Her sole Titan, Wildwood Druid, seems to represent a spirituality with nature-based powers and traditions. [Chasing Void]
===Spells Utilized===

* Bristlebind
* Hyperstride
* Kindlestrike
